text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai. With the first 
of her target races just ahead, Agnes 
Tachyon appears completely relaxed.

She declared that on her way to reaching 
"beyond the limit," she would gift her 
Trainer several victories.

And Agnes Tachyon, with a cynical smirk on 
her face, headed toward the race. From 
here... the curtain rises on her legend.
